pages.title: A Step Changes the Strike
pages.text: In battle mode complete a normal, sprinting and airborne attack with a supported weapon.

pages.title: A Step Changes the Strike
pages.text: Develop your chosen fighting style and prepare for the next encounter.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: The mode toggle defaults to R unless remapped. Use a supported ordinary sword and try the three contexts in a safe space. The airborne attack needs only a short jump.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Snowballs/freezing-tag items apply native slowing/freezing; igniting-tag items and torches ignite eligible targets. Immunities, actual impacts and native interval apply; no identical effect is promised for every boss.

pages.title: Useful to know
pages.text: Targets behind grass can be attacked without clearing the grass first. Enhanced AI is not universal: eligible mobs may bypass barriers, break cover or close distance. Vehicles/walls are not guaranteed safety. Attack animation does not determine server damage.
